# LinkedIn Profile Scraper + Email (No Cookies)

The Apify actor [`harvestapi/linkedin-profile-scraper`](https://apify.com/harvestapi/linkedin-profile-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.138**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract detailed information from LinkedIn profiles in bulk, including complete work experience, education history, skills and more. No cookies or account required.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Profile details $0.004, Profile details + email search $0.01 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/harvestapi/linkedin-profile-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/harvestapi-linkedin-profile-scraper@0.0.138#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `profileScraperMode` | string |  |  | Profile Scraper Mode (change this to find email) — Choose the mode for scraping LinkedIn profiles. 'Profile details' scrapes detailed profile information, while 'Profile details + email search' attempts to find the email address of the profile owner. |
| `queries` | array |  |  | Target URLs — List of LinkedIn profile URLs or Public Identifiers (last part in the URL) to scrape. |
| `urls` | array |  |  | Profile URLs — List of LinkedIn profile URLs to scrape. Provide at least one of the 3 fields: URLs or Public Identifiers or Profile IDs |
| `publicIdentifiers` | array |  |  | Public Identifiers (last part in the URL) — List of LinkedIn Public Identifiers. Provide at least one of the 3 fields: URLs or Public Identifiers or Profile IDs |
| `profileIds` | array |  |  | LinkedIn Profile IDs — List of LinkedIn profile IDs to scrape. Provide at least one of the 3 fields: URLs or Public Identifiers or Profile IDs |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
